title: Fairness Assessment reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong solution for Fairness Assessment should meet the objective: Compare task-relevant errors across selected groups on synthetic data and document the limits of the chosen group definitions and metrics. It should preserve a repeatable test setup, document its assumptions, and distinguish measured results from hypotheses.
explanation: Review the reasoning, not only the required words: inspect whether the test design matches the objective, the result is reproducible, and limitations are reported honestly.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
